description.p: Madlions Control is a native GTK4/libadwaita configuration tool for MADLIONS Hall-effect keyboards. It talks to the keyboard directly over its HID interface, so there is no browser tab, no vendor service and no account.

ul.li: Per-key actuation point and rapid-trigger sensitivity
Live analogue travel test with per-key heat map
Lighting effects, brightness, speed and per-key colours
Four-layer keymap editor and macro support
Advanced keys, SOCD, OKS, rapid snappy and DKS
Named profiles, presets, backups and a CLI for scripts

description.p: Settings are only persisted to the keyboard when you explicitly save. Nothing is uploaded or collected.

screenshot.caption: The overview keeps every important value in one place

description.p: Correctness and safety fixes for editing and restoring settings.

ul.li: Actuation preset and reset buttons now apply the selected value.
Lighting refreshes no longer trigger unintended side-light writes.
Saving reports a lighting-save failure instead of claiming full success.
Keymap and macro restores are verified by read-back, with shorter replies rejected.
Read-only macro editing is disabled, and backup deletion uses the exact file path.

description.p: Restored the smooth live test view.

ul.li: The Test page samples and redraws at 60 Hz again.
Idle repainting is still skipped, so an open Test page stays cheap when nothing moves.

description.p: Lower idle and live-test resource use.

ul.li: Telemetry runs at 30 Hz and stops repainting while the board is idle.
The live heat map redraws at 20 Hz, cutting active test CPU roughly in half.
Pages are constructed on first visit instead of all at startup.
See the keyboard's current Fn-layer shortcuts, including lighting controls.
Generate the list from layer 1, so it matches the user's keymap.
Open the Keymap editor from the cheatsheet.
Reset actuation, rapid trigger, lighting, switches and dead band to the observed baseline.
Creates a tuning snapshot first and leaves persistent data untouched.
Available on verified boards with an observed baseline, from the Profiles page or the CLI.
Malformed device replies can no longer stall keyboard I/O.
Full backups now include colours, keymap, macros and advanced keys.
Profile imports are size-limited, schema-checked and atomically saved.
CLI commands validate selectors and ranges, and read back writes.
Lighting controls are honestly read-only, and per-key black is preserved.
